## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend lint and tests pass
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass
- [ ] Docker Compose configuration validates, when applicable
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated together, when applicable

## Safety and release checklist

- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, private data, or generated local artifacts are included
- [ ] New or changed Agent behavior has tests for failure and safety paths
- [ ] Token and cost values are identified as measured, estimated, synthetic, or zero
- [ ] API, database, environment, and deployment impacts are described above
